summary: Our project is to simulate a mission to the moon. We created our project using Scratch by first making the sprites and drawing the parts, like an engine. Then we added the code to the parts. We had to research the weight and thrust of all the parts. We planned to first make the parts and menus, then make the code, and finally add destinations. Our project addresses the challenge by creating an interactive game that allows participants to design, manage, and simulate a complete space mission. Our project is important because it can help people learn about how space missions work.
details:
Our project is a game created using Scratch MIT. We simulated various aspects of a space mission, including earning money. Instead of applying for grants, players answer multiplication questions to earn funds for their mission. Additionally, players select parts for the main rocket, choose their launch vehicle, and navigate through space. This simple game helps players understand that space missions require careful planning and involve multiple steps.

Our team focused on key elements such as funding for the mission, selecting rocket parts, choosing launch vehicles, and managing time effectively. This project is creative because we programmed the game collaboratively without the use of AI. We also planned everything manually, using storyboards and charts. Finally, our game showcases creativity, as we dedicated time to design and illustrate all the components of the game.
